text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":4,"unit":"friends","kind":"count","span":"had 4 friends who came to visit"},{"id":"q2","value":20,"unit":"times","kind":"count","span":"first friend pressed on the doorbell 20 times"},{"id":"q3","value":4,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"1/4 times more than Jerome's first friend"},{"id":"q4","value":10,"unit":"times","kind":"count","span":"third friend pressed on the doorbell 10 times more than the fourth friend"},{"id":"q5","value":60,"unit":"times","kind":"count","span":"fourth friend pressed on the doorbell 60 times"}],"plan":[{"op":"div","args":["q2","q3"],"out":"s1","note":"a quarter of the first friend's presses"},{"op":"add","args":["q2","s1"],"out":"s2","note":"the second friend pressed a quarter more than the first"},{"op":"add","args":["q5","q4"],"out":"s3","note":"the third friend pressed ten more than the fourth"},{"op":"add","args":["q2","s2"],"out":"s4","note":"presses by the first and second friends"},{"op":"add","args":["s4","s3"],"out":"s5","note":"add the third friend's presses"},{"op":"add","args":["s5","q5"],"out":"s6","note":"add the fourth friend's presses for the total rings"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"the total number of times the doorbell rang across all four friends"},"dismissed":[{"value":4,"reason":"the head-count of 4 friends is structural: each friend's presses are given separately, so the count itself is never multiplied or added"},{"value":1,"reason":"the 1 is the numerator of the fraction 1/4; the fraction enters the plan through its divisor 4"}]}
